title: The double bishop sacrifice
line: Both bishops given up on h7 and g7 to strip the king.

steps.text: Lasker against Bauer, 1889: both white bishops point at the pawns in front of the black king.
Give the first bishop: take the pawn in front of the king, with check.
Take the knight with the queen, with check.
Now give the second bishop too: take the last pawn beside the king.
steps.hint: The other bishop aims at the pawn next to the king.
steps.after: The king took the bishop, and now it stands bare.

steps.text: Check with the queen and drive the king along.
Bring a rook toward the king. It will check from the side next move.
steps.after: The rook threatens mate, and Black can only give up the queen.
Black had to put the queen in the way.
White gave a rook for the queen. In the game the queen went to d7 next and attacked both black bishops.

summary: Give both bishops for the pawns in front of the king, then bring the queen and a rook against the bare king.
